text_block_list.text:
Спешл Уик takes the lead and finishes
with it.
Yet Грасс Вандер quietly claims
to have no
regrets.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Scores of fans impacted by her running
now have
high expectations for her next
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса visits Грасс Вандер after
the race
and issues yet another
challenge.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And with Сайленс Судзука also scheduled
to run,
the Mainichi Okan is shaping up
to become an
intense race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
